title: Digi CC Names
author: vega
description: Custom names for each MIDI CC per track on Digitakt I. On MIDI tracks (TRK 9-16), parameter pages (FLTR CC VALUE and AMP CC SELECT) show custom parameter names per track instead of generic VAL1..VAL8 and SEL1..SEL8. Open SETTINGS > MIDI CC NAMES to configure each MIDI track's 8 CC names, choose from built-in synth templates (Standard Synth, Minilogue, MicroFreak, Bass Synth, Drum/Sampler, Mod/FX, General MIDI), select from a library of standard parameter names, or enter custom names character by character. Fully compatible with digi1_mods.
